summary: The main article describes a dual photoredox/manganese catalytic system for atom transfer radical addition (ATRA), featuring optimization studies, substrate scope, and mechanistic investigations. The document includes 5 schemes and 1 table detailing reaction pathways, product yields, and radical clock experiments.

items.heading: Scheme 1
items.caption: ATRA reaction mechanism.
items.description: Compares typical ATRA mechanisms (chain and dual catalysis) with the current work using a manganese-based catalytic system.

items.heading: Table 1
items.caption: Optimization studies.
items.description: Lists various reaction conditions, including solvent and catalyst screenings, to optimize the yield of the ATRA product 3a.

items.heading: Scheme 2
items.caption: Synthesis of compounds 3. Isolated yields are shown.
items.description: Displays the substrate scope for the ATRA reaction with various alkenes and bromides 2a-b.

items.heading: Scheme 3
items.caption: Gram-scale synthesis and reactions of 3u.
items.description: Demonstrates the scalability of the reaction and subsequent transformations of the dibromide product 3u.

items.heading: Scheme 4
items.caption: Proposed mechanism.
items.description: Illustrates the catalytic cycles involving the photocatalyst and manganese salt for radical generation and bromine transfer.

items.heading: Scheme 5
items.caption: Radical clock experiment.
items.description: Shows the reaction of diallylmalonate to support the radical nature of the mechanism through intramolecular trapping.
